pages.text: Right-click a car to get in: the first one in drives, with one of its keys in your inventory. $(k:forward) $(k:left) $(k:back) $(k:right) drive and steer, $(k:jump) is the handbrake and $(k:sneak) gets out.$(br2)$(k:key.reikocars.horn) horn$(br)$(k:key.reikocars.lock) lock or unlock$(br)$(k:key.reikocars.hitch) hitch, load, tow, or a work vehicle's job

$(k:key.reikocars.siren) lights and siren (police, ambulance, fire)$(br)$(k:key.reikocars.signal_left) and $(k:key.reikocars.signal_right) turn signals$(br)$(k:key.reikocars.hazards) hazards$(br)$(k:key.reikocars.radio) radio$(br)$(k:key.reikocars.gps) GPS$(br2)All of these can be changed under Controls, in the Reiko's Car Mod section.
The dashboard shows your speed, fuel, the road and any warning lights.

$(l)Owning a car:$() whoever puts it down owns it. New cars start locked. Paint one by right-clicking it with a dye. Punch it a few times to pick it up (owner only): it keeps its fuel, paint, locks and wear.$(br2)$(l)Off-road:$() grass, sand, snow and dirt slow every car but the off-roader, the heavy-duty pickup, the farm tractor, the dump truck, the electric pickup and the dirt bike.

$(l)Headlights$() come on with the engine and really light the road in the dark, about twelve blocks ahead.$(br2)$(l)Running things over$() hurts mobs and knocks them aside; players only with PvP on. Cars climb a full block, so curbs and stairs don't stop them, and can't be blown up or burned.
